title: Turkey curry with onion and courgette
subtitle: Creamy without cream: evaporated milk does the job.
ingredients: 1-2 tsp curry powder, garlic, fresh ginger
steps: Fry onion, garlic and ginger in olive oil for 3 minutes.
Add the curry powder and toast it for 30 seconds.
Add the turkey and brown it for 3-4 minutes.
Add the courgette and the evaporated milk; simmer 8-10 minutes.
A squeeze of lemon to serve.
tip: Keeps 3 days in the fridge: cook it on Sunday for Monday's lunchbox.

title: Lentil stew with chicken
subtitle: A spoon dish from a jar of cooked lentils.
ingredients: 140g crushed tomato, 250ml water or stock, 1 bay leaf
steps: Brown the chicken in olive oil and set aside.
In the same pot fry onion, carrot and garlic for 5 minutes.
Paprika and cumin for 30 seconds, then tomato, water and bay leaf; cook 8 minutes.
Add lentils and chicken, 5 more minutes on low heat.
Lemon juice when serving.
tip: Vitamin C from tomato and lemon helps absorb the iron in lentils.

title: Wholewheat pasta with beef and courgette ragù
subtitle: The sauce hides a whole courgette.
ingredients: 300g crushed tomato, ½ onion, 2 garlic cloves
steps: Fry onion and garlic 4 minutes; add the beef and brown 5 minutes.
Add courgette and tomato; simmer 12 minutes.
Cook the pasta and mix, or serve the ragù on its own for a low-carb plate.

title: Salmon poke bowl
subtitle: Marinated fresh salmon, rice and avocado.
ingredients: ½ avocado, 50g chickpeas, grated carrot, lettuce
steps: Marinate the salmon in soy sauce and ginger for 10-15 minutes.
Build the bowl with rice, vegetables and avocado.
Salmon on top, sesame seeds to finish.
tip: Raw fish should have been frozen first (−20 °C, 24 h) to kill parasites.

title: Oven-baked sea bream with onion and courgette
subtitle: One tray, almost no washing up.
steps: Oven at 200 °C. Vegetables (and potatoes) in the tray with oil and salt, 15 minutes.
Fish on top with garlic, lemon slices and thyme.
15-18 minutes more, until the flesh comes off the bone.
tip: Works the same with sea bass or chicken pieces (35-40 minutes).

title: Roast chicken with vegetables
subtitle: Into the oven while you cook the week's batch.
ingredients: Chicken pieces or a small whole chicken
steps: Oven at 200 °C. Vegetables in the tray with oil and spices.
Chicken on top, whole garlic cloves around, rosemary and lemon.
Roast 40-45 minutes, turning once.

title: Mackerel salad
subtitle: No cooking: a tin, leaves and a dressing.
steps: Drain the mackerel.
Leaves and tomato on the plate, mackerel and egg on top.
Dress with oil and lemon.

title: Courgette and turkey flatbread pizza
subtitle: Dinner in 20 minutes with a tortilla as base.
steps: Tortilla in a large pan, tomato and oregano on top.
Turkey and courgette, cheese last.
Covered on medium heat 6-8 minutes until the cheese melts.

title: Garlic prawns with spinach
subtitle: Friday dinner in one pan.
steps: Golden the sliced garlic (and chilli) in olive oil, 1 minute.
Prawns, 2-3 minutes on high heat.
Spinach on top until it wilts; salt and parsley.
tip: Bread on the side to dip the garlic oil.

title: Oat and banana brownie
subtitle: Bake once, snack for days.
ingredients: 100g oat flour, 30g cocoa powder, 2 tsp baking powder
steps: Oven at 180 °C. Mash bananas with eggs and yogurt.
Add flour, cocoa and baking powder; fold in chocolate and walnuts.
Bake 22-25 minutes in a lined tin. Cool before cutting.
tip: No added sugar: the ripe banana sweetens it.
